species.description: The scientific name of the recorded species.

verbatimScientificName.description: The verbatim scientific name of the recorded species.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for species occurrence locations.

locality.description: The locality field is entirely empty, containing no recorded spatial information for any records.

stateProvince.description: Geographic state or province of the species occurrence, such as Islas Canarias or Madeira.

occurrenceStatus.description: The occurrence status of Erica canariensis, recorded as present.

individualCount.description: The individual count field is entirely empty across all records.

publishingOrgKey.description: Unique identifier for the publishing organization.

decimalLatitude.description: Decimal latitude coordinates of species occurrences, ranging from 27.73 to 32.83 degrees.

decimalLongitude.description: Decimal longitude coordinates in degrees, ranging from -18.13 to -15.51.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Coordinate uncertainty radius in meters for species occurrence records.

coordinatePrecision.description: The coordinate precision field is entirely empty across all records.

elevation.description: Elevation data is entirely missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy is entirely missing from the dataset.

depth.description: All values are missing, preventing determination of the depth measurement unit or data type.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy measurements for species occurrence records.

eventDate.description: Date and time of species observation, ranging from 1982 to 2026.

day.description: Day of the month for species occurrence records, ranging from 1 to 31.

month.description: Month of occurrence, expressed as an integer from 1 to 12.

year.description: Integer year of species occurrence, ranging from 1982 to 2026.

taxonKey.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier for the Erica canariensis taxon.

speciesKey.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier for the Erica canariensis species.

basisOfRecord.description: The basisOfRecord field categorizes the method used to document species observations.

institutionCode.description: The institution code identifies the source of the occurrence records.

collectionCode.description: The collection code for the species occurrence records is consistently labeled as Observations.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each Erica canariensis occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: This column is entirely empty and contains no data.

identifiedBy.description: Identifier of the person who identified the Erica canariensis specimen.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time when the Erica canariensis specimen was identified.

license.description: License identifier specifying Creative Commons usage terms for the occurrence data.

rightsHolder.description: The rights holder for each occurrence record.

recordedBy.description: Identifier of the individual who recorded the species observation.

typeStatus.description: This column is entirely empty, containing no recorded data values.

establishmentMeans.description: All values are missing, preventing determination of the establishment means for these occurrences.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of the last data interpretation for each occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media type of the occurrence record, primarily still images.

issue.description: Semicolon-separated flags indicating data quality issues such as rounded coordinates or missing taxon identifiers.
